problem_statement: When a border router delegates a DHCPv6-PD prefix and uses it as its OMR prefix, but the same prefix is also advertised on-link by a router (a DHCPv6-PD server misbehaving by assigning the same prefix to multiple requesters), the border router incorrectly keeps using the conflicting PD prefix as its OMR. The router should detect that the delegated PD prefix appears as an on-link prefix in a received RA and, in that case, stop using it as the OMR and fall back to its locally-generated OMR prefix (with the default route). When the on-link advertisement later expires and the PD prefix remains valid (and is renewed), the PD prefix should again be used as the OMR. Delegating a PD prefix that already appears on-link before it is delegated should likewise not cause it to be used as the OMR until the conflict is gone.
